text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Come on, come on! 
Dance with us, Brian-san!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I'm on duty. 
Student council officers do not dance.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~? Aren't the Droit committee members 
handling pretty much all the work?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
A-A-And besides, knowing you, Brian-san, 
you're just slacking off like usual, 
aren't you! 
Maya can totally tell☆

Tonight was the annual dance party, 
Droit—'Ligne Droite.'

During one of the events, DJ Time, 
the horsegirls were enjoying freeform 
dancing.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Found you, Brian-chan, Maya-chan♪ 
Aren't you two going to dance?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'm inviting Brian-san right now! 
But she's being a total stick-in-the-mud~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, you're right. 
With that expression, it might indeed be 
difficult, wouldn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
In that case—perhaps I'll go on ahead and 
dance. 
Feel free to join once you two feel like 
it♪

Sakura Laurel began to dance. It was 
graceful, but by no means 
tame. There was an intense passion running 
through it. 
And her gaze was fixed resolutely in a 
single direction—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...Laurel-san...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(...It's so weird. She's just dancing. 
She's just looking at us, and yet—)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(It's like I can actually hear 
Laurel-san's voice speaking to me—!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
'Brian-chan, Maya-chan. 
At long last, I can stand proudly before 
you both.'

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
'No more anxieties hold my legs back. 
With every ounce of speed I possess! I can 
fight you now!'

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
'So please, meet me head-on with 
everything you have!'

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...A declaration of war, is it?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
! ...Maya won't... —Maya won't back down 
either!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(Laurel-san's dance was so passionate. 
Like all her tucked-away feelings just 
exploded outward.)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(And yet, just like at the Cherry Blossom 
Festival—it's so dignified. 
It made me feel, 'Now that's a mature 
woman.')

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya gets it now! 
A mature woman's dance isn't—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(It isn't just about hiding your feelings. 
It's about pouring all those feelings into 
the dance!)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(I'm not gonna lose! 
Not to Brian-san, and not to Laurel-san 
either!)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(Together with Trainer! 
Maya's gonna beat them both!)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: (—Right, Trainer?!)

Mayano Top Gun's eyes, 
her dance, conveyed her message with fiery 
eloquence. 
It was as though her voice rang out clear 
as day—!
choice_data_list: Yeah! We're definitely going to win!
Yeah! We're definitely going to win!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(! It reached you! 
Maya's feelings reached Trainer—!)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! Maya's getting so hyped up! 
Takeoff all the way to the edge of the 
sky☆

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, to think you'd answer back with 
dance. 
I'm as thrilled as can be too, Maya-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I have no intention of playing around. 
On the turf—I will devour you whole.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehe, hooray! 
It reached you two loud and clear too!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Trainer♪ 
How was Maya's dance?

From beginning to end, 
it brimmed with Mayano Top Gun's burning 
passion. 
Her eyes, filled with deep emotion, were—
choice_data_list:
You looked quite a bit more mature than 
usual, I think.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeeeek, really?! 
Yay! Maya felt it too!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I bet I can totally dance it now— 
like a real mature grown-up woman!

title: Toward Where the Elegant Dancing Fingers Point
